stories.title: LeBron chooses 76ers, calls it his 'last decision'...
stories.summary: LeBron James is signing with the 76ers on a two-year, $8 million deal with a player option, Klutch Sports Group CEO Rich Paul told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Grading LeBron to the 76ers: Why he could put Phil...
stories.summary: LeBron James is signing with Philadelphia on a two-year, $8 million deal. How much can he help them?

stories.title: Kim cards 15th ever 59 in PGA Tour history at 3M
stories.summary: Michael Kim carded the 15th 59 in PGA Tour history on Friday, making a 24-foot putt for birdie on the 18th hole at the 3M Open.

stories.title: Sources: Duke-Michigan scrapped over TV issues
stories.summary: A nonconference men's basketball matchup between Duke and Michigan has been called off after broadcast rights issues couldn't be resolved, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Germany coach Klopp: Will quit if treated poorly
stories.summary: Jürgen Klopp started his tenure as Germany's head coach with a threat to leave the job if the media does not respect his family's privacy
